request.deadline: 18 months from approval, with milestones at Month 6, Month 12, and Month 18
deliverables: 18-month programme across India, Cambodia, and Kenya

M1 Month 6: Foundation operational, 200,000 cumulative farmers registered on Mainnet, AE credentialing live, trust-layer architecture locked, auditor procurement concluded, legal contract transfer prepared

M2 Month 12: 350,000 farmers across India, Cambodia, and Kenya, three application paths operating against verified records, first stablecoin-rail loans disbursed and tracked, Foundation governance operational, first independent audit
M3 Month 18: 500,000 cumulative verified farmers, three application paths operating, finance activity on Cardano, AE network credentialed, Foundation revenue model active, final independent audit
Application paths for AE certification with Andamio, traceability and compliance with Zengate Global, and finance and credit with Seedstars SIGMA
request.recipient: 5am.earth Foundation / Intersect-administered treasury reserve and project-specific smart contract framework
request.what: 5am.earth Foundation requests treasury funding to build an open Cardano-anchored trust layer for global agricultural supply chains combining Veridian SSI, a Cardano on-chain satellite oracle, and partner application paths.

claims.claim: Project Swaminathan is operating on Cardano Mainnet with 10,500 cumulative farmer and farm registrations as of 5 May 2026.
The pilot phase from January to March 2026 validated 1,056 farms at a 100% blockchain success rate and handled a Phase 3 critical patch with zero downtime.
The proposed programme will scale to 500,000 registered or verified farmers across India, Cambodia, and Kenya by Month 18.

The trust layer will use already implemented and operational Cardano components including AIQuant and Anastasia Labs smart contracts, DigiFarm satellite data, Veridian DID, Andamio credentials, and NMKR tokenisation.
The proposal asks for 10,000,000 ADA with milestone-gated payments of 5,000,000 ADA on approval, 2,000,000 ADA on M1 acceptance, and 3,000,000 ADA on M2 acceptance.
The 10,000,000 ADA ask is described as approximately 2.86% of a ratified 350,000,000 ADA Net Change Limit.
Surplus above $3.5 million will return to the Treasury, while the Foundation may retain up to $3.5 million for scope elasticity.
By 2030, the proposer projects 3 million farmers, 112.5 million annual on-chain transactions, $900 million TVL, and 16–20 million ADA in annual protocol revenue.
Intersect will administer the proposal using the Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and Project-Specific Smart Contract framework with oversight from five external entities.
By 2028, the Foundation expects to be self-sustaining through commercial revenue and institutional backing without returning to the Treasury for operating costs.

summary: The document requests 10,000,000 ADA for an 18-month, milestone-gated agricultural trust-layer scale-up, citing existing Project Swaminathan Mainnet activity, named partners, governance controls, and large future adoption and revenue projections, while much of the feasibility, budget sufficiency, and long-term economic upside is asserted rather than evidenced in the supplied text.
